reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: Art. IV entitles Licensor only to accrued usage-based payments for trades already performed, Art. XXI imposes only return/certification obligations, and Art. XXIII expressly bars termination damages for both parties — no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee or minimum-fee true-up appears.

The rationale correctly characterises the p0064 audit-cost shift (cost reimbursement on >5% discrepancy) as outside the LD rule and defers the one-sided remedies/liability-cap issues to the relevant rules, avoiding double-flagging.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes the clause meets the preferred position rather than merely the fallback; retaining it as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue is correct.
